title: Evia Coach review drafting
details: Milos now receives Evia's anonymous review-period Coach Snapshot during the normal learner progress scan
Learner profiles show activity since the last review including Evia sessions, course movement, evidence, OTJ or GLH, targets, confidence and assessment practice
The factual parts of the progress review are pre-filled from Evia evidence and remain editable by the assessor
Employer contribution, apprentice contribution, wellbeing and support, training-plan changes and professional judgement still require the three-way review discussion
